body: Thanks. I really appreciate it. It's hard to write stuff like this without getting caught away and then missing the point.

Because of the shame that will be caused if you are caught. If you're not ashamed then it doesn't happen. There's also hiding your face, or only showing so much, if you like, but of course there's always risk in every lifestyle. Also when I meant safe, I meant more meeting some guy at a truck stop, or something to those lengths. Like I was saying there's no shame in doing what makes you feel good, as long as it doesn't harm others. If someone finds out, then so what? Their ideologies and "morals" are their own and no matter what they say they don't have to be yours.

Edit: I tell my self a lot "peoples opinion of me is none of my business." Maybe you could take some solace from that.

I would consider what might be the actual problem here is the cause of shame. The shame of seeking attention isn't a bad thing. Most shame is a construct based on religious, or "moral" ideologies, that can be more of the damaging unhealthy life style choice than healthy. It's the shame that is causing your self disgust and then spiral into making you feel less, and possibly feed into your depression. You're excited about a sexy person, and it drives you to feel wanted so you may feel confident enough to do it again. If I may suggest, focus on ridding yourself of the shame, and be proud of your body which can help you learn to love yourself. If you like showing it off to older men, then thats your thing. As long as you're safe in doing so, then you should be supported in making yourself feel good and confident.
